_README: Host evidence template for the attendance Windows-native exact-SHA QA v2 matrix. In the reworked flow the route-less HARNESSES write most of these cases automatically (status + reason + evidence + a STRUCTURED machineEvidence record + the safety fields they can attest) into <evidence-dir>/summary.json; the operator affirms the Windows-only host facts and fills the HTTP/UI cases. The qa-runner validates SAFETY + SHA binding + an evidence contract that FAILS CLOSED on missing/malformed evidence and on a wrong/stale SHA. For a PASS it additionally requires a case-shaped, tooling-SHA-bound structured evidence record of one of two kinds: machineEvidence@1 for PQA-09/10 (the ONE whitelisted harnessModule for that case + that case's exact facts schema), or operatorEvidence@1 for PQA-01..08 (tester + UTC timestamp + command/route + expected/observed + artifact sha256 + bound source/tooling SHAs; PQA-05/06/08 additionally require a truthful per-case boundaryAttestation). That raises the bar from 'any long string an operator can type' to 'a case-shaped record bound to a real harness/artifact and the package tooling SHA' — it is NOT a proof of authenticity (this JSON is copyable and operator-writable), and the runner never judges product correctness. Ships every case status=BLOCKED with empty reason/evidence, no machineEvidence, and unaffirmed safety fields on purpose: a straight copy without doing the work reports BLOCKED, never PASS. REACHABLE STATES: a green --strict (10/10) IS reachable, but ONLY via genuine evidence. PQA-09/10 PASS on a whitelisted-harness machineEvidence@1; PQA-01/02/03/04/07 PASS on a well-formed operatorEvidence@1 from a genuine HTTP/UI run; PQA-05/06/08 PASS only if their operatorEvidence carries a truthful per-case boundaryAttestation (full objective executed) — else BLOCKED. A hand-typed envelope with a non-whitelisted harnessModule or invented facts is REJECTED, and off-Windows the host-safety facts hold everything BLOCKED; the tooling ALONE (no Windows operator, no artifacts) reaches at most 09/10.

_fill_instructions.closed_set: cases[] must be EXACTLY the ten matrix ids PQA-01..PQA-10 — no missing, no extra, no DUPLICATE ids. The runner rejects any violation.
_fill_instructions.sourceSha: Leave as the pinned SHA; must equal the package SOURCE_SHA (0dc3596dd...). qa-runner BLOCKS any mismatch or stale SHA. May be top-level and/or per-case.
_fill_instructions.runId: The campaign runId that binds this summary, every per-case evidence record, and each artifact manifest entry to ONE run (8-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._-]). The harnesses stamp it (env QA_RUN_ID or .runtime/run-id); a PASS requires it, and any per-case evidence/artifact whose runId differs is REJECTED (old-run replay).
_fill_instructions.residue: Set to the number returned by residue-check.sql AFTER drop/recreate teardown. PASS requires 0. Leave null until measured. (Top-level, single global measurement.)
_fill_instructions.per_case_safety_fields: PER-CASE ONLY (no top-level fallback): isolatedDatabase=true, databaseName=metasheet_windows_qa, hostPlatform=windows, windowsPowerShellVersion=5.1.x, customerOrExternalDestination=false, externalNotificationsSent=false. A shared top-level affirmation no longer covers any case.
_fill_instructions.cases[].status: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED. Start BLOCKED. A PASS additionally requires the RIGHT structured evidence kind for the case: machineEvidence@1 for PQA-09/10 (see cases[].machineEvidence), operatorEvidence@1 for PQA-01..08 (see cases[].operatorEvidence). PQA-05/06/08 additionally require a truthful boundaryAttestation. All ten CAN reach PASS via genuine evidence, but you cannot hand-type a PASS: a non-whitelisted harnessModule / invented facts / a thin operatorEvidence is rejected. Set FAIL on any product deviation.
_fill_instructions.cases[].reason: Non-empty per-case evidence note; REQUIRED for PASS (whitespace-only is rejected).
_fill_instructions.cases[].evidence: Non-empty per-case step output / SQL result / file reference; REQUIRED for PASS (whitespace-only is rejected). The harnesses fill this from real execution.
_fill_instructions.cases[].machineEvidence: REQUIRED for PASS on PQA-09/10 ONLY (an operatorEvidence here is REJECTED — strict partitioning) — a STRUCTURED record a harness emits (schema 'windows-qa/machine-evidence@1', producedBy 'windows-qa-harness', caseId (= this case's id), runId (= summary.runId), the ONE whitelisted harnessModule FOR THAT CASE — PQA-09 => pqa-09-outbox-retry.mjs, PQA-10 => pqa-10-scheduled-sweep.mjs, determination='PASS', qaToolingSha matching the package QA_TOOLING_SHA, and a facts object matching that case's EXACT schema). Operators do NOT hand-type this: it is produced by the pqa-09/10 harnesses. A wrong caseId (cross-case masquerade), a non-whitelisted harnessModule, a missing/invented/wrong-typed fact, or a runId != summary.runId is REJECTED; a present-but-wrong per-case/top-level qaToolingSha is rejected, not ignored.
_fill_instructions.cases[].operatorEvidence: REQUIRED for PASS on PQA-01..08 ONLY (a machineEvidence here is REJECTED — strict partitioning) — a STRUCTURED operator record (schema 'windows-qa/operator-evidence@1') with caseId (= this case's id), runId (= summary.runId), tester, timestamp (UTC ISO ending in Z), command or route, expected, observed, artifact { path (relative to the evidence dir, no '..'/absolute), sha256 (64-hex — the runner RECOMPUTES it over the real file: a missing/tampered file, a symlink, or a path escaping the evidence dir is REJECTED), runId (= summary.runId) }, sourceSha (= package SOURCE_SHA), qaToolingSha (= package QA_TOOLING_SHA). PQA-05/06/08 additionally require boundaryAttestation attesting the FULL objective (PQA-05: legacyProjectionUnchanged=true + shadowCalculationRowsAppended>=1; PQA-06: outcome='review_required' + dailyProjectionNull=true; PQA-08: oldSnapshotUnmutated=true + mismatchReviewRequired=true) — a thin operatorEvidence stays BLOCKED. A record/artifact whose runId != summary.runId (old-run replay) is REJECTED.
_fill_instructions.cases[].qaToolingSha: Optional; if present it MUST equal the package QA_TOOLING_SHA (the runner rejects a mismatch rather than ignoring it). The authoritative binding is machineEvidence.qaToolingSha.
_fill_instructions.cases[].syntheticDataOnly: Per-case affirmation that only synthetic orgs/users/shifts/punches were used. PASS requires true.
